A rapid revision of times left John just inches away from the National record A bitter disappointment, but he has regained his 1973 lead and is only the third Briton (after Andy Holden and Dave Bedford) to break 8:30.

Runners finishing after him read like a list of who's who in English cross country: 18.A.Holden; 19.P.Standing; 22.R.Wilde; 23.D.Bedford; 27.K.Steer.....Crabb, Cannon, Beevor, Tagg....What a great pity that we did not turn out our best side to back him up and give ourselves a more respectable team place.

Andy Holden (Tipton/Lancs) led a small group at the 5 mile mark but from thereon gradually pulled away from the rest of the field. Don Faircloth (Croydon/Surrey) ran a good race to move through to 2nd place at the end.
